observations.posthog_connection: This token prevents credential leakage. The agent never sees the user's password or warehouse credentials; it only receives a token and the warehouse's integration ID. This supports PostHog's warehouse-connect flow, where an AI agent relays warehouse credentials without ever exposing them.
